name: The kit's UI in the TV, mobile and experimental layouts, as admin on Long Test Movie. TV layout (localStorage 'layout' = 'tv', what Settings > Display stores; html.layout-tv): the details page's Add bookmark button and section, the editor, the player's three buttons and its bookmarks list. Mobile layout at 375x812 touch ('mobile'; html.layout-mobile): the same, with the editor and the list as full-width bottom sheets and touch-sized icon buttons. Experimental layout ('experimental'): with the page demo on, the fallback routes #/jfbm-demo-a and #/jfbm-demo-b render, and no 'Library tools' nav appears (the kit adds it to jellyfin-web's legacy drawer, which this layout keeps hidden); what Bookmarks' details UI does there is recorded. Adds a range bookmark and removes it at the end, and turns the page demo on and back as it was, through the API (sandbox data only); the layout is stored per browser, and each run has a fresh profile.

steps.name: find Long Test Movie
steps.eval: (await ApiClient.getItems(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), { IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie', Recursive: true, SearchTerm: 'Long Test Movie', Limit: 1 })).Items[0].Id

steps.name: the movie has a range bookmark 1:00-1:04 ('webcheck-layouts')
steps.script: const url = (p, q) => ApiClient.getUrl(p, q); const list = await ApiClient.getJSON(url('Bookmarks', { itemId: __vars.movieId })); if (!list.some(b => b.Note === 'webcheck-layouts')) { await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: url('Bookmarks'), data: JSON.stringify({ ItemId: __vars.movieId, StartTicks: 600000000, EndTicks: 640000000, Note: 'webcheck-layouts' }), contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' }); } return (await ApiClient.getJSON(url('Bookmarks', { itemId: __vars.movieId }))).length;

steps.name: TV: the Add bookmark button and the section with the range
steps.waitFor: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('#itemDetailPage:not(.hide) .mainDetailButtons .btnBookmarkItem'); const s = document.querySelector('#itemDetailPage:not(.hide) .jfbm-section'); if (!b || !s || s.classList.contains('hide')) return false; const row = [...s.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-row')].find(r => r.textContent.includes('webcheck-layouts')); const r = b.getBoundingClientRect(); return !!row && r.width > 0 && r.height > 0 && { layout: document.documentElement.className, kitLayout: __jfkit.jfbm.instance.layout.isTv(), rows: s.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-row').length, button: [r.width, r.height] }; })()

steps.name: TV: the kit sees the TV layout
TV: the editor, with focus in the Name field (the start field before 1.1)
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel'); return !!p && p.querySelector('h3').textContent === 'New bookmark' && document.activeElement === p.querySelector('input[maxlength="100"]'); })()

steps.name: TV: details page with a Play button
TV: open the player's bookmarks list
TV: the list dialog with the range
mobile: the Add bookmark button and the section with the range, inside the screen
steps.waitFor: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('#itemDetailPage:not(.hide) .mainDetailButtons .btnBookmarkItem'); const s = document.querySelector('#itemDetailPage:not(.hide) .jfbm-section'); if (!b || !s || s.classList.contains('hide')) return false; const row = [...s.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-row')].find(r => r.textContent.includes('webcheck-layouts')); if (!row) return false; const rr = row.getBoundingClientRect(); const icons = [...row.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-icon-button')].map(i => { const r = i.getBoundingClientRect(); return [Math.round(r.width), Math.round(r.height)]; }); return { kitLayout: __jfkit.jfbm.instance.layout.isMobile(), rowLeft: Math.round(rr.left), rowRight: Math.round(rr.right), scrollWidth: document.documentElement.scrollWidth, icons }; })()

steps.name: mobile: the kit sees the mobile layout; the row fits in 375 px; its icon buttons are at least 40 px
mobile: scroll the section into view
mobile: the editor
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel'); return !!p && p.querySelector('h3').textContent === 'New bookmark'; })()

steps.name: mobile: the editor is a full-width bottom sheet
steps.eval: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel'); const r = p.getBoundingClientRect(); return { left: Math.round(r.left), right: Math.round(r.right), bottom: Math.round(r.bottom), height: Math.round(r.height) }; })()

steps.name: mobile: details page with a Play button
mobile: open the player's bookmarks list
mobile: the list dialog with the range
mobile: the list is a full-width bottom sheet
turn the page demo on (the developer setting EnablePageDemo; per request)
steps.script: const id = 'd0ee1b2a-7f71-4654-8ff2-163a81441b03'; const c = await ApiClient.getPluginConfiguration(id); const before = { EnablePageDemo: c.EnablePageDemo, EnableDemoPageB: c.EnableDemoPageB }; Object.assign(c, { EnablePageDemo: true, EnableDemoPageB: true }); await ApiClient.updatePluginConfiguration(id, c); return before;

steps.name: on #/home before the reload (a hash-only goto returns early)
reload (experimental; index.html now carries the demo's head fragment)
the kit sees the experimental layout
experimental: the drawer and nav state
steps.eval: (() => { const shown = (e) => { if (!e.getClientRects().length) return false; const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); const cs = getComputedStyle(e); return r.width > 0 && r.height > 0 && r.right > 0 && r.left < innerWidth && r.bottom > 0 && r.top < innerHeight && cs.visibility !== 'hidden' && cs.display !== 'none'; }; const ours = [...document.querySelectorAll('.jfkit-nav, [data-jfkit-plugin]')]; const legacy = document.querySelector('.mainDrawer'); return { ourNavInDom: ours.length, ourNavShown: ours.filter(shown).length, legacyDrawerInDom: !!legacy, legacyDrawerShown: !!legacy && shown(legacy), libraryToolsText: document.body.innerText.includes('Library tools') }; })()

steps.name: experimental: no 'Library tools' nav and no link of ours is shown (jellyfin-web's legacy drawer, where the kit puts them, stays hidden in this layout)
Demo page A by its fallback route
experimental: Demo page A renders in #fallbackPage, 'Page not found' hidden
steps.waitFor: (() => { const r = [...document.querySelectorAll('#fallbackPage > [data-jfbm-page="demo-a"][data-jfbm-mounted]')].find(x => x.getClientRects().length > 0); const nf = [...document.querySelectorAll('#fallbackPage > :not([data-jfbm-page]) h1')].some(h => h.getClientRects().length > 0); const user = r && r.querySelector('[data-jfbm-demo="user"]'); return !!r && !nf && !!user && user.textContent !== '…' && { title: r.querySelector('.jfbm-demo-title').textContent, host: r.getAttribute('data-jfbm-host'), user: user.textContent, documentTitle: document.title }; })()

steps.name: Demo page B by the page's own link
experimental: Demo page B renders
steps.waitFor: (() => { const r = [...document.querySelectorAll('#fallbackPage > [data-jfbm-page="demo-b"][data-jfbm-mounted]')].find(x => x.getClientRects().length > 0); const nf = [...document.querySelectorAll('#fallbackPage > :not([data-jfbm-page]) h1')].some(h => h.getClientRects().length > 0); return !!r && !nf && location.hash.startsWith('#/jfbm-demo-b') && { title: r.querySelector('.jfbm-demo-title').textContent }; })()

steps.name: experimental: still no nav of ours shown
experimental: what Bookmarks' details UI does here (recorded)
turn the page demo back as it was
steps.script: const id = 'd0ee1b2a-7f71-4654-8ff2-163a81441b03'; const c = await ApiClient.getPluginConfiguration(id); Object.assign(c, __vars.demoBefore); await ApiClient.updatePluginConfiguration(id, c); const r = await ApiClient.getPluginConfiguration(id); return { EnablePageDemo: r.EnablePageDemo, EnableDemoPageB: r.EnableDemoPageB };

steps.name: back to the stable layout for this browser
remove the 'webcheck-layouts' bookmark
steps.script: const url = (p, q) => ApiClient.getUrl(p, q); for (const b of await ApiClient.getJSON(url('Bookmarks', { itemId: __vars.movieId }))) { if (b.Note === 'webcheck-layouts') { await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'DELETE', url: url('Bookmarks/' + b.Id, { deleteClip: 'true' }) }); } } return (await ApiClient.getJSON(url('Bookmarks', { itemId: __vars.movieId }))).length;
